visual.title: Sine and cosine from one coordinate pair
visual.caption: On the unit circle, read the point first, then the functions. The angle places P in a quadrant, the signs of its coordinates give the signs of cosine and sine, and the reference angle gives the acute angle to the x-axis. The graph below shows the same values at the same angle.

predict.question: At θ = 210°, what are the signs of cos θ and sin θ?
predict.explain: 210° is in quadrant III, where both coordinates are negative. The reference angle is 30°, so the point is (−√3/2, −1/2). Therefore both cos 210° and sin 210° are negative.
